bands.gap: sample x minus the trailing-edge midpoint x at the nearest spanwise station

bands.empty: a band with no samples is reported as null; the band edges are never moved

gap_summary.note: the smallest reachable distance is set by the wake triangle size, because samples are interior points of their triangle; a band below the smallest reachable gap is empty by resolution, not because the flux there is zero

definitions.gap: sample x minus the trailing-edge midpoint x at the nearest spanwise station
definitions.first_row: wake triangles sharing at least one node with a declared trailing-edge edge
definitions.historical: relative_near = centroid x_gap <= 0.5*max|x_gap| (control only, centroid based)
definitions.bands: fixed x_gap / Cref intervals evaluated per sample; the first band also absorbs any sample with x_gap < 0
definitions.empty: a band with no samples is reported as null; the band edges are never moved

wake_report.sampling: 4 points per wake triangle (centroid plus three interior barycentric points), area weighted, both mirrored halves; every sample is banded by its own x_gap / Cref and the smallest reachable gap is set by the size of its wake triangle
